# ML Rust catalogue

Rust projects for machine learning: libraries on crates.io, and apps.
Tiers come from published rules over raw signals. Each published claim links its source.

## Data
- Every entry as JSON: https://ml-rust.github.io/data/catalogue.json
- What the JSON fields mean: https://ml-rust.github.io/data/README.txt
- Tier rules: https://ml-rust.github.io/rules/
- Atom feed of changes: https://ml-rust.github.io/changes/feed.xml
- License of the data: CC-BY-4.0

## Topics
- Machine learning: https://ml-rust.github.io/topics/ml/
- Tensors: https://ml-rust.github.io/topics/tensors/

## Categories
- Inference runtimes: https://ml-rust.github.io/categories/inference-runtimes/
- Tensor libraries: https://ml-rust.github.io/categories/tensor-libraries/
- Vector databases: https://ml-rust.github.io/categories/vector-databases/
